MEET THE ARTIST / 새소년

SE SO NEON

SE SO NEON’s music combines blues, psychedelic rock and pop, led by Hwang Soyoon’s voice and guitar. The act won Rookie of the Year at the 2018 Korean Music Awards.

PSYCHEDELIC ROCK / 2017

The Wave파도

Live performance

View release on Apple Music ↗

First released as a single in September 2017 and included on Summer Plumage that October, “The Wave” won Best Rock Song at the 2018 Korean Music Awards. This official live version was filmed at the 2020/NEON concert on December 7, 2019, at YES24 Live Hall. Let it run through the extended instrumental finish.
